theorems.name: Submission.plane_disint_pointwise_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ η : Measure (Grassmannian N n), IsProbabilityMeasure η ∧ ∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / (V.weight (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ S, β S ∂η))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
